rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Devin renders no trust dialog for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. Its composer is a bare prompt glyph, so the rendered busy footer is what acknowledges the submit. The first Escape must be proven to have landed on a running turn before the second is sent: the same fast double Escape on an idle agent opens its revert picker, where a later Enter reverts file changes. A running turn renders `esc again to interrupt`, and the picker is dismissed with Escape, never Enter. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. Devin runs operator and Recon work only. While a turn runs the pane carries `esc twice to interrupt` and a working composer; idle it carries neither. A manual cancellation emits no Stop, so a recorded busy state is invalidated to unknown instead of being trusted.
